annotations.instruction_text: Insert vendor information for those that can provide bottled or bulk potable water

annotations.instruction_text: Insert sources of stored “non-potable” water in the building and on the campus. Include pools, wells, ponds, streams, boiler tanks, etc.

annotations.heading_context: Loss of Water Service / Contamination of Water Supply

annotations.instruction_text: Insert vendor information that can provide non-potable water, typically bulk tanker water that can be used for building operations and/or the fire suppression system
